entities.summary: Quinn Gleason is an American professional tennis player. She has career-high WTA ranking of world No. 50 in doubles, achieved in March 2026 and No. 323 in singles. Gleason has won two WTA Tour, four WTA 125 doubles titles and 15 on the ITF Circuit as well as one singles title.
